cases.title: Enable and status
cases.expected: Register both listeners and the five-tick sampler. Report alert-only mode to the administrator.
notes: 2 listeners registered. Timer delay and period are both 5 ticks in the fixture.
[AntiCheat] Sprint 3 active | Checks: Speed, Flight | Mode: alert only

cases.title: Command permissions
cases.expected: Deny status, recent and reload to a sender without anticheat.admin.
notes: 3 of 3 direct command-handler calls denied. Admin recent returned 0 entries.

cases.title: Ordinary horizontal travel
cases.expected: At a simulated 4 blocks per second, record zero speed flags with the default limit of 8.
notes: 4 samples at approximately 4 blocks/s with an 8 blocks/s limit. Disk records = 0.

cases.title: Two fast samples
cases.expected: Keep the first fast sample pending and record SPEED on the second consecutive sample.
notes: Disk records after fast samples 1 and 2 = 0, then 1.

cases.title: Interrupted speed streak
cases.expected: A low-speed sample breaks the streak. Two new high samples are needed.
notes: 20, 4, 20 blocks/s produced 0 flags. One more 20 blocks/s sample produced 1.

cases.title: Teleport and reconnect
cases.expected: Clear speed history across a teleport and a quit/join, then detect a fresh two-sample streak.
notes: 0 flags across both resets. Two fresh high samples produced 1 SPEED record.

cases.title: Speed exemptions
cases.expected: With identical fast travel, flag only the ordinary control among the exempt player states.
notes: Ordinary control = 1 flag. All 11 exempt states = 0 flags.

cases.title: Threshold reload
cases.expected: After editing the copied config from 8 to 2 and running reload, flag 4 blocks per second in the same instance.
notes: Same 4 blocks/s input. Threshold 8 = 0 flags. Threshold 2 after reload = 1 flag.

cases.title: Jump and landing
cases.expected: Leave four ordinary jump-shaped movement traces unflagged.
notes: 4 scripted jumps with a landing between each. Disk records = 0.

cases.title: Level airborne travel
cases.expected: Hold through 14 level, position-changing air moves. Record FLIGHT_HOVER on move 15.
notes: 14 level air moves = 0 records. Move 15 = 1 FLIGHT_HOVER.

cases.title: Sustained ascent
cases.expected: Hold through 16 upward moves of 0.12 blocks. Record FLIGHT_ASCEND on move 17.
notes: 16 rising moves = 0 records. Move 17 = 1 FLIGHT_ASCEND.

cases.title: Flight exemptions
cases.expected: For the same level air path, flag the ordinary control and spare the selected exempt states.
notes: Ordinary control = 1 hover flag. All 13 selected exempt states = 0 flags.

cases.title: Flight history resets
cases.expected: Landing, teleport and reconnect clear accumulated air moves before a fresh streak.
notes: 0 flags through landing, teleport and reconnect. Fresh move 15 produced 1 hover flag.

cases.title: From movement to moderator history
cases.expected: A flight flag reaches authorized chat, a console warning, the disk log and the recent command.
notes: 1 registered-listener flag, 1 staff chat, 0 ordinary-player chats, 1 console warning. Recent exactly matched disk.
[AntiCheat] TestPlayer failed FLIGHT_HOVER (0.00)

cases.title: Last 20 and disk persistence
cases.expected: Append 25 distinct test records. Return the newest 20 in order before and after reopening the same folder.
notes: 25 records on disk. The command returned rows 6–25 in order both times. New instance loaded the same 20 from the file.
First retained observation = 14.000. Last retained observation = 33.000.

cases.title: Staff alerts and cooldown
cases.expected: Throttle repeated chat for the same player and check. Keep all four disk records and warnings.
notes: 4 flags = 4 disk entries, 4 warnings, 3 staff alerts, 0 messages to either sender without the alerts permission.

cases.title: Disable staff chat
cases.expected: With alerts disabled in the reloaded config, keep warning and saving violations.
notes: With alerts.enabled=false, 0 staff alerts, 1 warning and 1 disk entry.

cases.title: Cooldown configuration lifetime
cases.expected: Apply a new cooldown after constructing a fresh plugin instance and retain the old duration across reload.
notes: Flags 1.2 seconds apart produced 1 chat after reload and 2 chats with a fresh instance.

cases.title: Stationary hover coverage
cases.expected: Probe whether the hover check can flag continued suspension at identical coordinates.
notes: 1 airborne movement followed by 40 identical-position events produced 0 flags. The current hover check needs position changes.

cases.title: Water exemption in the README
cases.expected: Probe the README's water exemption for a fast-moving player in water with the swimming flag off.
notes: At 20 blocks/s in a water block, the non-swimming input produced 1 SPEED flag. The swimming input produced 0. The README describes water more broadly.
